quests.display_name: The Plate on the Last Lamp
quests.briefing: The last Sector 4 lamp has a brass plate over the stencil. Maren Holt is finishing a crate of spares. Ivy will not cross. Yara will not come south. The seam is the first room of the pack. The route cannot start in a menu.

stages.text: Inspect the post. Plate vs stencil. Four screws, one of them the wrong metal.
The seam. Ash on one side of a survey nail. Salt-white on the other.
Inspect the oil tin. Leave, take, or split. Overlay pigment in a smaller pot.
Open the plate crate or refuse. Dark until the post has been inspected.
Speak to Maren, or to the empty crate.

choices.text: Screw the plate. Brass over stencil.
Scrape the plate. Stencil reads again in a day.
Leave both layers. The post means two things.

quests.briefing: Convoy 12's hold is a blotter and a dead telephone. Overlay printed plates would replace the grease pencil. Copying the pencil discovers the grid convoy slots. Replacing it mutates the map. The hand will still be under there, paler.

stages.text: Enter the lobby. The published timetable is pre-Exchange and wrong.
Inspect the map glass. Grease pencil: convoy slots, arrows, a circle twice around Convoy 12.
Sit the DOB desk. The blotter: a child's birth year written twice, once crossed through.
Radio gallery. The last turn-back order.
Choose the overlay bench: install, crate, or palimpsest.

choices.text: Install Overlay print. The hand is paler under glass.
Crate the print. The grease pencil stays the document.
Palimpsest. The map means two things, which is already its job.

quests.briefing: Garrison already searched for the Schedule. Overlay is filing site plates into municipal drawers. The brick may hold a field index. It will not hold households.

stages.text: Vestibule visitor book. Sign or don't.
The grey brick. Dig hours: collapse risk. Or leave it. Or pull the half-sunk plate.
Reading cage. Copy the field index or take it. Ira will know the difference.
Loading dock. Crate stencilled RECORD / NOT SCHEDULE.

choices.text: Dig. Free a field index, or sink the plate deeper.
Leave the brick. The Garrison looked twice.
Pull the half-sunk plate. The index stays in the geology.

quests.briefing: Ira Vell has the Standing Record. The visited column is empty until you have been. Overlay wants the book out. A photocopy in inventory does not fill the Vault cage. The book has a column for that. It is empty until the column is not a lie.

stages.text: Stair authenticator.
Enquiry memo.
Scoring floor. Occupation points. Frayne absent, clerks nine.
Registrar: see the book. Do not skip.
Obstacle annex. D/9 paper, not a Dead Hand crawl.
Dead phone blotter.
Copy in place, take, Overlay receipt, or refuse.

choices.text: Copy in place. Incomplete copy. Ira knows.
Take it. Overlay wants it out.
Overlay receipt. The book leaves with a plate trail.
Refuse. The visited column stays honest-empty.

quests.briefing: Osric Tann prices mass. Overlay lots have no kilograms. Edor may be waiting. Stand on the scale or put a plate on it. It will read as mass. That is the only number Osric will write.

stages.text: Stand on the scale. Osric will write a mass.
Hut. Calibration weight on its hook, or not, if Overlay borrowed brass.
Receipts: copy, steal the white stack, or leave.
Lot stack on the beam: install, crate, or palimpsest column.

choices.text: Install lots on the beam. District 8 can pathfind by number.
Mass only. The needle has no opinion.
Both columns disagree. Clerks lose hours.

quests.briefing: The Verge names places by hand and waiting list. Overlay names them by lot. Dara Mewn waters a plot. If levy took the caretaker, the hut is dark and Overlay has already been.

stages.text: Grange porch. Leave weapons here. The sign has been relettered.
Ledger: names vs numbers. A rifle tag with a cross in the ledger inside.
Kitchen notice. Overlay plated a notice for the drawer instead.
Allotments gate.
Noticeboard sleeve. Plot 114 is still 114.
Named plot. A plate with a different 114. Dara waters this one.
Brass bin. Plates mixed with fittings. Same metal.
Vote, or leave the Overlay notice.

choices.text: The Verge keeps names. The plate does not go on the row.
The plate goes on the plot. Two 114s in the dirt.

quests.briefing: Overlay clipboard: friendly obstacle. D/9 already marked the rail. Looking from the span is a room. Checking the detonator is a branch that mutates Toll access - not an action setpiece.

stages.text: Near bank.
Span. A stone on the marked side of a scupper. Do not move it. That is not mercy.
Underside. Look, refuse, check the housing.
Survey clipboard. Sign, scrape, or copy.

choices.text: Sign. The span is a listed charge in the Record.
Check the housing. The Tollman does not need to be present for the authority to work.
Copy the line. Ostrowski's sheet will match.

quests.briefing: COMPLETE plate vs mid-cycle gauges. Benno lives in the failure. Overlay cannot close a flood with brass. District 8 can file it closed. They can screw COMPLETE on the leaf. The leaf is still where it stopped.

stages.text: Towpath. Nomi etiquette if the Shallows were used.
Control wheel. The gate froze mid-cycle.
Benno's bunk. Copy his rise-chart or not. Water-heights, dates.
Gauges. They believe the failure.
Gate leaf. Where it stopped.
Reclaim plate. Leave, scrape, or palimpsest.

choices.text: Leave COMPLETE. A flood becomes a closed file.
File the gauges. Honest. The Drown reads it.
Take the plate down. The leaf is still where it stopped.

quests.briefing: Overlay refreshes 12-B as a finished overflow address. The kit is water. The stencil is a levy map. Pump Nine condemned keeps the Vault far; one dry motor is a room that changes travel.

stages.text: Stair chalk. Fourteen marks, a gap, then six. Do not close the gap.
Unprovisioned hall.
Kit: leave, take, or copy notes only.
Water cup. The kit is water.
Stencil: refresh, scrape, or original.
Optional: Pump approach. Dry motor vs condemned tag.

choices.text: Refresh the stencil. 12-C can cite 12-B as a pool.
Keep the original. The gap stays part of the fallback.
Energise the dry motor. The Drown lowers a step.
Honour the tag. Sublevels stay shut.

quests.briefing: Quil will not file plates without spoken site names. Sole will not enter ground on one testimony. Maren waits in the airlock with hats of brass. The player writes which gazetteer stands. Not from the bunker.

stages.text: Window entry.
Dusted room. The crate undusted on purpose.
Name desk. Say sites or refuse. If you don't say it, you're only copying.
Refused crate. String-tied. A plate is a copy that does not have a mouth.
Vault dock. Etiquette.
Airlock plates. Maren's hats of brass.
Stacks.
Sole's table. Two witnesses, or nothing.
Second-copy cage. Filled only if the route was walked.
The book's place. File Record, lived map, both, or nothing.

choices.text: File the Record. Posts have numbers. Lived names are subtitles.
File the lived map. Plates in a crate, string-tied.
File both. Nobody likes either.
File nothing. Benno's gauges are the only honest document.

quests.briefing: Reconstruct the final hours of the Command Vault before the airlock was breached. Compare the oxygen scrubber logs with spent brass casing locations to determine if the garrison mutinied.

stages.text: Inspect the dog-bolt torch scars on the outer vault door.
Map the cartridge ejection patterns in the security anteroom.
Recover the charred teleprinter log from the dispatch terminal.
Synthesize the timeline: mutiny followed by external sealing.

choices.text: Record the mutiny evidence in the civic chronicle.
Suppress the mutiny records to preserve military reputation.

quests.briefing: Train 14 sits derailed in the darkness beyond Platform 3. The dispatch clock stopped at 08:42. Investigate whether the track switch was thrown intentionally to trap civilian evacuees.

stages.text: Examine the manual track switch lever in the signal tower.
Recover the ticket collectors brass ticket punch and passenger manifest.
Inspect the carriage luggage racks for government evacuation crates.
Determine who threw the switch and lock the history in the record.

choices.text: Attribute the crash to deliberate sabotage by the stationmaster.
Conclude the derailment was caused by panic and structural track fracture.

quests.briefing: Thirty-four brass shift tokens remain on the pegboard outside Adit 4. Descend into the coal gallery and discover whether the miners escaped through the emergency ventilation raise.

stages.text: Count the unclaimed brass tokens on the lamp cabin board.
Navigate past flooded coal seams to the Adit 4 barricade.
Read the chalk inscriptions left on the timber cribbing.
Recover the foreman pocket ledger detailing their survival days.

choices.text: Chalk their names onto the surface shaft headframe.
Strip the miners brass carburetors without registering their names.

quests.briefing: A layer of magnesium slag fills Archive Vault 3. Sift the residue to reconstruct burned directives regarding the evacuation of District 8.

stages.text: Collect heat-fused carbon fragments from drawer column G.
Treat the ash sheets with glycerine to reveal faint typewriter impressions.
Transcribe Directive 88-Delta regarding preferential shelter priority.
File the recovered directive in the central dossier.

choices.text: Expose the preferential evacuation quota to the public.
Keep the evidence secret to leverage against surviving officials.

quests.briefing: Examine the sheared gear teeth on Sluice Gate 4. Did the coastal flood barrier fail due to poor metallurgy or did a technician intentionally cut the gear pins?

stages.text: Inspect the sheared bronze pinion teeth with a magnifying loupe.
Locate the maintenance logs in the lockmasters cabin.
Identify the saw marks in the keyway slot.
Reconcile the metallurgical findings into a site dossier.

choices.text: Confirm deliberate industrial sabotage in the lock record.
Record catastrophic storm surge fatigue as the official cause.

quests.briefing: Canister 44 in the Seed Library Annex was emptied and resealed with common grain. Trace the missing cold-hardy wheat seeds through pre-war checkout cards.

stages.text: Weigh Canister 44 and verify the seal wax discrepancy.
Check the checkout card for Agronomist Lindas signature.
Search the basement cold-frame for hidden germination vials.
Recover the true frost-resistant seed stock.

choices.text: Deliver the heirloom seeds to the agricultural community.
Store the seeds securely in your own emergency vault.

quests.briefing: A discrepancy in the exterior wall thickness of the Logistics Reserve suggests a concealed sub-basement room omitted from the official blueprint.

stages.text: Measure the basement masonry with a surveyor plumb-line.
Locate the false brickwork behind the coal bunker.
Breach the mortar seam to reveal the hidden supply annex.
Catalog the preserved pre-war antibiotic ampoules and surgical steel.

choices.text: Draw the annex onto the public warehouse plan.
Conceal the entrance again for exclusive shelter access.

quests.briefing: The main security turnstiles at Transit Authority HQ are permanently welded shut. Search the mechanical ducts for an unblocked bypass route.

stages.text: Inspect the intake louvres behind the HVAC fan bank.
Crawl through Duct 11-East past frozen bird carcasses.
Kick out the interior ceiling grille above the central archive.
Unlock the inner security door from the inside.

choices.text: Wedge the security door open with an iron crowbar.
Leave the door locked and keep the vent duct as a secret entrance.

quests.briefing: A flooded basement under Atlantic Cold Store contains submerged copper evaporator coils. Map the layout before the sea ice cracks.

stages.text: Wade into the knee-deep saltwater sump beneath the packing floor.
Survey the brine tank manifolds and copper refrigeration tubing.
Sketch the drainage valve network onto your expedition pad.
Salvage sixty kilos of industrial copper pipe without triggering a wall collapse.

choices.text: Carefully unbolt the coils without damaging structural supports.
Blast a drainage hole through the outer foundation wall.

quests.briefing: The gas and high-voltage electrical conduits intersect at Chamber 7. Align the conflicting utility drawings to bypass a collapsed boulevard.

stages.text: Trace the yellow gas main and black high-voltage cable runs.
Compare the 1982 electrical schematic with the 1991 municipal overlay.
Isolate the live telephone junction box and test line voltage.
Open the subterranean transit crawlway to the western district.

choices.text: Tap the live municipal cable to power the underground tunnel lights.
Keep the junction dark to avoid attracting scavenger patrols.

quests.briefing: Locate the unmarked graves of eight ironworkers who died erecting Railway Span 44 during the evacuation winter, and chisel their initials into the granite abutment.

stages.text: Recover the payroll sheet from the construction shanty rubble.
Locate the eight burial mounds beneath the frozen ballast.
Use a hardened steel chisel to inscribe their names into Pier 4.
Place an iron rivet on each carved name in the traditional ceremony.

choices.text: Inscribe all eight names in deep, permanent Roman lettering.
Slap red primer paint crosses on the concrete and move on.

quests.briefing: Ascend the frozen ridge to the Summit Relay Spire. Recover the final transmission log of the mountain watch team and ignite their memorial beacon.

stages.text: Climb the ice-sheathed iron rungs up the radio mast.
Recover the magnetic tape cassette from the weather-hardened transmitter.
Stack granite stones around the base of the mast to build a five-foot cairn.
Fill the iron brazier with diesel fuel and light the high beacon.

choices.text: Light the summit brazier. The flame is visible across three valleys.
Erect the stone cairn silently without lighting the fuel.
